items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Glaser booked me. We never could get along but I love Glaser. He's somebody that I always cared for and I think he was very fond of me. I went to him and he booked me on a lot of things. I worked for him for quite a while

ctx.x: No, we got married in Memphis.

No, but they went to school together. Joe Williams was from Kansas City, Kansas; and John was from Memphis, Tennessee, but he went to school in Kansas City. That's where he met Joe. When we went to Memphis, Tennessee, that's where John Williams my husband - who later became my husband - was born and so we got in the band together. He was such a terrific man. The union musicians there - they had no union when I was there - he got a union going for them. The musicians would work like from 8 o'clock till 3 or 4 in…
